question.text: When a Category III AIF transacts on the RFQ platform in 'one-to-many' mode and the trade executes against another AIF, the trade is counted as:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular dated October 19, 2022, if a Cat III AIF enters in 'one-to-many' mode and gets executed with another AIF, the trade is counted in 'one-to-many' — not 'one-to-one'. **The Trap:** The counterparty being another AIF does not convert the execution mode; it stays as placed. **Cross-Exam Context:** Reconciling RFQ metrics is commonly tested in compliance audits. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Log the original placement mode — switching classification later could under-report the 10% floor.
